Russian President Vladimir Putin speaks to Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei. The call took place as part of high-level consultations between Tehran and Moscow regarding heightened tensions between Iran and the US. During the call Putin expressed Russian support for Tehran and hailed the resilience of Iranian people.
